topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: My neighbor approached me the other day, her voice full of hope, asking if she could use a corner of my yard for a garden. I’ve known her for years, always friendly, always kind. The thought of saying no feels heavy, like stepping on a delicate thread that holds our community together. A garden might add some beauty, a splash of color. But my yard isn’t exactly a blank canvas—it’s a space I’ve tended to, with my own plans. I found myself stammering a bit, trying to weigh her enthusiasm against my own reservations. I promised to think about it, hoping to find a way to say yes without overstepping the boundaries of what feels right.
